topology_scope: Every new native material part is watertight/winding-consistent/positive; union volumes avoid overlapping-material mass double count. This does not approve connection, pressure-wall, seal, buckling or carrier.
finite_curve_discretization: Native 48-sided circular material probes; nominal radii at vertices, maximum radial chord sagitta below 0.10mm for 46mm outer radius. Ideal hydraulic force uses nominal analytic circular area, no manufacturing tolerance acceptance.
collision_scope: Actual C15 armor_cover/armor_surface and primary_structure* native materials, posed via same source C2 body transforms; old visible-mechanism drive proxies excluded. No collision-free whole leg or complete multi-axis installation claim.
